newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, but quoted lower, cautious.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, but quoted lower, cautious.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were cautiously lower around midday on Monday as NYMEX extended sideways movement.
July Brent on SIMEX was untraded but quoted at $19.25/$19.35 per barrel, down from London's settlement on Friday of $19.40.
NYMEX July crude was last traded in light ACCESS dealings at $20.85 per barrel, down three cents from Friday in New York.
Both markets ended the week cautiously and in narrow ranges on Friday after volatility through the week.
Brokers said SIMEX would be cautious also and would probably wait for further leads on direction from London and New York overnight.
